metadata.attribution: Illustrative historical-redlining sample for the swelter demo network.
metadata.source: Illustrative sample placed on the synthetic demo network's published grid cells. NOT a real HOLC determination for this fictional location. A real deployment replaces this with actual digitized HOLC grades for its jurisdiction from Mapping Inequality (only cities HOLC surveyed in 1935-1940 are covered — many places have no HOLC map at all, and that absence should be shown as 'no data', never as an assumed grade) — see docs/adr/0018-exposure-brief-and-equity-context.md.

properties.notes: Illustrative grade only — this demo network's coordinates are synthetic, not a real digitized HOLC area.
properties.source: Illustrative sample (swelter demo) — real source: Nelson, Robert K., LaDale Winling, et al., "Mapping Inequality: Redlining in New Deal America," ed. Robert K. Nelson and Edward L. Ayers, American Panorama: An Atlas of United States History (Digital Scholarship Lab, University of Richmond), 2023
